definitions.gloss: just before; verge; brink; right at the moment of
definitions.explanation: The moment immediately before something happens. Indicates the very last moment or the brink of an event or deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{間際|まぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang just as I was about to leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{間際|まぎわ}になって⟦{慌|あわ}てて→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: I rushed to finish it right before the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧{間際|まぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: On the verge of death, he left his final words for his family.

notes:
Typically follows a verb in dictionary form or a noun: ～{間際|まぎわ}. Emphasizes the very last moment before something occurs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{間際|まぎわ} (just before departure)
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{間際|まぎわ} (right before the deadline)
- ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧{間際|まぎわ} (on the verge of death)
- ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧{間際|まぎわ} (just before closing time)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- verb (dictionary form) + {間際|まぎわ} (just before doing ~)
- noun + {間際|まぎわ} (just before the ~)

Similar to ⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧ (immediately before), but {間際|まぎわ} has a more vivid, moment-by-moment feeling.
